book.name: MATAIOꞌ
book.title: IZESUꞌ KILISITOꞌNIMUꞌ GAMAZI LAMINEꞌ MATAIOꞌ GIZINEꞌ

content: Izesuꞌni Sataniꞌmo Emenguꞌ Molaniꞌ Gamazi Gizineꞌ
Neꞌmine ogavo Sataniꞌmo emenguꞌ molalingumuꞌ ve lo Sikalahuꞌ neꞌmo eleꞌmizo ebeꞌ hadivela dizineꞌ.
Eleꞌmizo dizavo aꞌmida nosoꞌ niteꞌ malise ogo ongo oto ineꞌ nene gamene foti (40) nominivo alingeꞌ gaꞌna goloso helo minineꞌ.
Gaꞌna helo neivo ngemenguꞌ molaaꞌ ive aza Izesuda ogo tiꞌ lo lo-imineꞌ: Gaza Oꞌmosoꞌmi gipele noo ma geheni mevomuꞌ lanivo nalineꞌ initeꞌ beleti liliꞌ ilo lovo.
Neꞌmine lavo Izesuꞌ tiꞌ lo lo-imineꞌ: Oꞌove, monoꞌ godolouꞌ gamazi ma tiꞌ li gizi nizaniꞌ ma neive:

content.text: Eveneꞌ minevoꞌ alevote nene nosoꞌ nitekukovoꞌ nomive.
Oꞌmosoꞌmi veletiꞌ gamazi mukitoꞌ nesi ha minevoꞌ alevoꞌ olosune.

content: Neꞌmine li gizi nizaniꞌ nenako nemuꞌ nene geiꞌ laineꞌ neꞌmine nene mo amolosuve.
Neꞌmine lavo Satani aza Izesuꞌni eleꞌmizo Zelusalemi ebekuꞌ vo monoꞌ numuno naba haꞌna haꞌna minineꞌ neꞌmi gololoꞌ eleꞌmizo dize mino
tiꞌ lo lo-imineꞌ: Monoꞌ godolouꞌ tiꞌ li gizi nizaniꞌ ma neive:

content.text: Oꞌmosoꞌmo geikumuꞌ angeloꞌve gono gamazi lo-ngedeleseive.

content: Idoꞌ ma nene:

content.text: Gizenga gehedoꞌ gebele gulutilingutiꞌ angeloꞌ nete alete mili
di hozi li-gidilisave li gizi nizaniꞌ ve.

content: Idoꞌ aꞌmine gamazi lidoꞌ igi neꞌmine i-gidilisaze. Gaza lamineꞌ Oꞌmosoꞌmi gipele noo ma melotiꞌ oluto akaꞌmeloꞌ izevo.
Neꞌmine lavo Izesuꞌ tiꞌ lo lo-imineꞌ: Ne neiha monoꞌ godolouꞌ gamazi gohi ma tiꞌ li gizi nizaniꞌ ma neive:

content.text: Lingine Guvetinesi ve Oꞌmoso golo izamilo.

content: Neꞌmine lo-leme neineꞌ nenako geze nolaineꞌ nene Oꞌmoso golo izaaꞌ noloseinako neꞌmine amolosuve.

Neꞌmine lavo Satani aza gohi eleꞌmizo golo haꞌna haꞌna maloꞌ dize mino eveneꞌ zuho ato atoꞌ misuboꞌninguꞌ misuboꞌninguꞌ amuzoꞌinesi minaniꞌ idoꞌ gonoliseꞌine lamineꞌ tamineꞌ ato atokisi minaniꞌ nene elebizo
tiꞌ lo lo-imineꞌ: Gaza neniꞌ gubuꞌ ize nemo nopoꞌni lilineꞌ nene initeꞌ noningaineꞌ akaꞌme nene gemelesuve lineꞌ.
Neꞌmine lavo Izesuꞌ aza tiꞌ lo lo-imineꞌ: Monoꞌ godolouꞌ tiꞌ li gizi nizaniꞌ ma neive:

content.text: Laza Guvetesi ve Oꞌmoso eiꞌ hamoꞌ nene opoꞌni lo gubiꞌ ize emo minelesune.
Ee, eiꞌ hamokovoꞌ nene gelekeleꞌ o-do minelesune.

content: Neꞌmine li gizi nizaniꞌ nenako nemuꞌ nene gaza laineꞌ neꞌmine amolosuze. Satani gaza hulo-nedo vo haha ozo.
Lavo nelotiꞌ Satani aza hulo-do vavo Izesuꞌ neida angeloꞌ sotoꞌ igi nasahiliꞌ igi hize eleꞌ i-daniꞌ ve.
nGalilaia Misubouko Izesuꞌ Gonoꞌve Apiꞌ Ogo Doꞌmo Vineꞌ Gamazi Gizineꞌ
Idoꞌ Zohaneꞌni nene nalaꞌ numunguꞌ huli-daniꞌ nemuꞌ gelo Izesuꞌ aza nGalilaia misubouko vineꞌ.
Vo Nasalete ebeꞌ hulo Kahanaumi ebeta vo minineꞌ. Kahanaumi ebeꞌ nene nGalilaia noso ohuno gahevela Zakoboꞌ gipele Zebuloniki Nahataliki ngaꞌvopilemoꞌ zuho engiꞌ misuboꞌninguꞌ ongo minineꞌ.
Neꞌmine ineꞌ nene Oꞌmosoꞌmi veletiꞌ gamazi lo sotoꞌ ogaꞌ ive polohete Isaiaꞌni Oꞌmosoꞌmo lo-imineꞌ gamazi ma neꞌmine lo lineꞌ ma nene ogo gihile izineꞌ:

content.text: Litiꞌmusouꞌ gopo Zebuloniꞌ misuboukisi Nahataliꞌ misuboukisi
idoꞌ noso ohuno nabaꞌmi gahevela idoꞌ Zodani noso liginela
Zuda ve minamaniꞌ aleveti misubo nGalilaia neuꞌ minave ingine
Ee, aꞌmine aleve liꞌnimuso luꞌninguꞌ ize minivo minave ingine
mudise hilaaꞌ akaloꞌ mini mili minave engita labanaꞌ nene

content: Aꞌmine gamenelotiꞌ Izesuꞌ nene monoꞌ tiꞌ lo lo-ngemekaꞌ ngemekaꞌ oꞌmo monineꞌ: Oꞌmosoꞌmi gizebouꞌ vo holosoꞌ gamene mo alitaze. Lutine gatine di velepeꞌ izilo.
Izesuꞌ Aza Alahaꞌ Daaꞌ Ave Sitaꞌve Sitaꞌve Ezela Alizangumuꞌ Asi Lo-ngimineꞌ Gamazi Gizineꞌ

Izesuꞌ aza tiꞌ oꞌmo nGalilaia noso ohuno nabaꞌmi gahevela nomono uvolohoi akunoloi ma guliveꞌine Simoniꞌ ve gulive gohi ma Petoloꞌ aza nakunolo Adeleakisi alahaꞌ daaꞌ asive minasinako alahaꞌ daaꞌ asineꞌ golalezeꞌine nene alahaꞌ dalisa nosouꞌ nihulasivo ningineꞌ.
Ningo tiꞌ lo lo-ngimineꞌ: Lingine igi neꞌmetilizo. Alahaꞌ daaꞌ nasineꞌ neꞌmini eveneꞌ di nenita igaꞌ ilisive loloꞌ o-lengedelesuze.
Neꞌmine lavo ingine liteꞌ li alahaꞌ daaꞌ asineꞌ golalezeꞌine nene hitiki eꞌmeti vasineꞌ.

Ve sitaꞌ nene do giꞌmizo ngomo ma novo uvolohoi akunoloi gohi ma Zebedaioꞌ gipele sitaꞌ guliveꞌine Zakobokisi idoꞌ akunolo Zohanekisi ingine meꞌnibo Zebedaioꞌ nesi sipiuꞌ mini alahaꞌ daaꞌ aniꞌ golalezeꞌine nene ongoti di lamineꞌ igi nizavo ningo neꞌmetilisive lo asi lo-ngimineꞌ.
Neꞌmine lavo liteꞌ li oti meꞌnibinesi sipi nesi huli-ngidi eꞌmeti vasineꞌ.
Izesuꞌ Eveneꞌ Mukiꞌ Nasahiliꞌ O-ngidineꞌ Gamazi Gizineꞌ

Idoꞌ nGalilaia misubo mukikuꞌ mone mone ogo monoꞌ numunoꞌine mininguꞌ mininguꞌ monoꞌ apize ngemo Oꞌmosoꞌmo eveneꞌ do giꞌmizo gizebo o-ledelineꞌ gamazi lamineꞌ nene lo-ngemekaꞌ ngemekaꞌ ogo eveneꞌ initeꞌ gizi davesi gilizevo alevesi mukiꞌ nene do lamineꞌ o-ngedeꞌmo monineꞌ.

Neꞌmine ogavo guvele nene Silia misubo mukikuꞌ nene mono osuꞌ lavo initeꞌ ato atoꞌ gizi di mulumo gilave mukiꞌ nesi idoꞌ sikalahuꞌ goloso luꞌninguꞌ minive idoꞌ lemo lise-ngedaaꞌ ive idoꞌ gizeꞌine aꞌnine gulupese ive mukiꞌ nene Izesuda ngeleꞌmizi ikevo do lamineꞌ o-ngidineꞌ.

Idoꞌ eveneꞌ mukiꞌ vaiꞌ goloso nGalilaia misuboukotikisi idoꞌ Dekapoli misuboukotikisi Zelusalemi ebekutikisi idoꞌ Zudaia misubouꞌ minaniꞌ ebeꞌ linge malatikisi Zodani noso helala minineꞌ misuboukotikisi igi di geseꞌ igi eꞌmetaniꞌ.
